trial_court: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Madhepura - Complaint Case No.1053 of 2009
case_name: Md.Javed & Ors vs State Of Bihar & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Md.Javed, Md. Imtiyaz, Sheikh Jasimuddin @ Sk.Jasimuddin @ Sk.Jasim, Bibi Mohsina Khatoon, Bibi Khusbu, Md. Sayeed Akhtar (brothers-in-law, father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law and husband of sister-in-law)

facts_of_case: Complainant alleges harassment, torture and ill-treatment by husband and family members including petitioners; petitioners claim allegations are false and complainant is not staying at matrimonial house.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party making the allegation to prove it.
legal_principles.held: Having regard to the circumstances and upon consideration of the rival submissions.
cited_cases: Md.Javed & Ors vs State Of Bihar & Anr, (2010)

legal_principles.principle: A party's conduct can be considered in determining the outcome of a case.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel for the complainant appears and opposes the prayer made on behalf of the petitioners and submits that these petitioners are equally responsible for the disharmony that has occurred in marital life of the complainant.
cited_cases: Md.Javed & Ors vs State Of Bihar & Anr, (2010)

outcome.final_order: Petitioners released on bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Madhepura.
